race.comment: FLYING STRAZ (4) got the job done in grand style last start, scoring by one length over this journey at Donald after stalking the lead. That followed a couple of second placings and the recent runs have been in races no tougher than this, so he looks the testing material from a good gate. CARIBBEAN VILLA (1) is back from a spell of 3.5 months and does go well when fresh, including a win to launch last campaign over 1100m at Horsham. Leading contender. SHYLEAH (5) did her best work late and finished third last time over 1000m at Casterton, beaten 1.3 lengths. Will trim down following recent racing. In the right race and is one of the better hopes. AMBELLO (2) has been freshened since finishing fourth over 1200m at Casterton. Kept up to the mark with a recent Donald trial. Comes here with definite winning claims.
